name: insurance
description: Halcyon Assurance — per-aircraft hull insurance run out of the Halcyon tower. Buy a fixed-term policy at the underwriting desk (`insure`); a covered crash files a claim you collect at the claims desk (`claim`) for a PARTIAL payout (fraction of agreed value, minus a fat excess) with the insurer keeping the wreck. Every paid claim surcharges your future premiums — softens a crash without making planes disposable (anti-kamikaze). Reacts to the flight plugin's `flight.crashed` event. Later: property + other assets.

insure.note: KNOWN GAP: desk is a zone flag, not an examinable object.

insurebind.note: Point-of-sale bind for one aircraft; surfaced as an action-link in the flight dealer's buy confirmation, also usable at the insurance_desk.
